facts.text: The hotel occupies the Crown Building, dating from around 1921, a Beaux-Arts landmark.

facts.text: Suite design has a Japanese sensibility, such as textured paneling behind the bed that resembles a shoji screen.

facts.text: Each private Spa House has a private terrace with a cold plunge and hot bath.

facts.text: The Spa Houses are centred around either a traditional Banya or a Hammam experience.

facts.text: The hotel has a three-floor wellness facility including an indoor pool, Fitness Centre, Cold Plunge Terrace, sauna and steam room.

facts.text: Arva is Aman New York's signature Italian restaurant.
Akari presents Kaiseki and Omakase at an intimate hinoki wood counter.

facts.text: The Garden Terrace is open year-round and serves light bites.

facts.text: Alfresco dining is heated and covered during winter.
facts.excerpt: Encompassed within the cityscape, and heated and covered during winter, delight in the pleasure of al fresco dining.
